unq.brannoch_maul.desc: Your slam attacks (Peal, Final Knell…) cause an aftershock moments later (120% damage).
unq.brannoch_maul.lore: The overseer learned the language of stone by striking it. It was the only tongue he mastered.
unq.brannoch_maul.name: Brannoch's Broken Maul
unq.dissonant_lash.desc: Chain Bell bounces between enemies (3 times) instead of piercing.
unq.dissonant_lash.lore: A broken chain that still wants to return to its bell.
unq.dissonant_lash.name: Dissonant Lash
unq.echo_ring.desc: Your dodge leaves a sonic replica that draws enemies and bursts after 3 s. (4 s internal cooldown)
unq.echo_ring.lore: “Don't leave entirely,” she asked. And the ring obeyed.
unq.echo_ring.name: Ring of the Lingering Echo
unq.ember_gloves.desc: Enemies that die burning spread the burn to those nearby (5 m).
unq.ember_gloves.lore: The fire of the Long Dissonance never quite went out.
unq.ember_gloves.name: Gloves of Contagious Embers
unq.ildra_lens.desc: Your Full Chord marks enemies you hit while active and lasts 2 s longer.
unq.ildra_lens.lore: Through it, Ildra read the score. Now you see what she saw.
unq.ildra_lens.name: Precentor's Lens
unq.inverted_bell.desc: Peal heals the Belfry for 3% of life per enemy hit.
unq.inverted_bell.lore: Hung upside-down so the sound falls upon its bearer.
unq.inverted_bell.name: Inverted Bell
unq.living_fork.desc: All your spells deal sonic damage and you gain +25% sonic damage.
unq.living_fork.lore: It hums even when no one touches it. It hums for you.
unq.living_fork.name: Living Tuning Fork
unq.rest_pendant.desc: You can equip one more Voice, and your Voices have +1 charge.
unq.rest_pendant.lore: A circle with a notch. You always knew what was missing.
unq.rest_pendant.name: Pendant of the Rest
unq.rhythm_scarf.desc: Perfect dodges refund a dodge charge and grant extra Tempo.
unq.rhythm_scarf.lore: Its wearer hears a pulse no one else hears. They follow it.
unq.rhythm_scarf.name: Beat Scarf
unq.serene_crown.desc: Your Radiance never overloads (holds at 99) but Incandescent activates 25 points sooner.
unq.serene_crown.lore: The Prismatist learned, too late, that shining is not burning.
unq.serene_crown.name: Crown of Serene Radiance
unq.silence_mantle.desc: You are immune to Hush and Silence. Listening slows you less.
unq.silence_mantle.lore: Woven by those who chose to say nothing. It says everything.
unq.silence_mantle.name: Mantle of Silence
unq.stalker_claw.desc: Killing enemies reduces the cooldowns of your leaps and charges by 2 s. (0.5 s internal cooldown)
unq.stalker_claw.lore: No stalker dies entirely: it stays in the hand that killed it.
unq.stalker_claw.name: Stalker's Claw
